parsed.summary: Tracing the schematic against the specification, the spec-emphasised points all check out: the CAN controller crystals (Y4, Y2) are 16 MHz as required (the 14.7456 MHz crystals Y1/Y5 belong to the SC16IS752 UARTs, which is correct), the LTC4412 + P-channel MOSFET ideal-diode path (U36/Q3) is present, the SN74LVC1G07 e-stop sinks drive an ESTOP_OUT net (NET0095) that is shared with the CAN connectors, and Ethernet/USB TVS protection is in place. Reference-designator differences between the spec's netlist (U8/U9/U11 etc.) and this build (U15/U32/U28 etc.) are build/revision naming, not functional deviations, and items the spec lists as open TODOs (RTC, GLOBAL_EN sequencing, CAN LED polarity) are not contradicted by the drawing. I could not find a drawing-supported deviation that would change the board's behaviour.
